data.action: 抱枕坐在床中央，散发披肩红瞳惺忪，傲娇别脸又偷瞄
data.camera: medium shot, seated on bed, morning softness, intimate atmosphere
data.description: 【四宫家寝室·清晨】难得的假日清晨，辉夜卸下了折叠马尾，黑发如绸缎般披散过肩——那是只有『冰』融化时才允许出现的柔软。她抱着枕头坐在大床中央，晨光穿过蕾丝窗帘落在发梢，红瞳带着刚睡醒的湿润，傲娇地别过脸去——「……只、只准看一秒哦？……才、才不是特意为你散开的呢。」
data.lighting: 蕾丝窗帘过滤的柔白晨光
data.promptProse: Kaguya Shinomiya sits at the center of her bed holding a pillow, her black hair loose instead of folded into its usual ponytail. Her white cotton summer dress has thin straps and a navy chest ribbon. She turns away with sleepy red eyes and a hesitant blush. The medium view includes the padded headboard and lace curtain beyond; filtered morning light brightens loose hair tips and the pillow seam, leaving shallow shadows in the bedding.
data.title: 四宫辉夜 · 冰融晨光的散发时刻·「只准看一秒……才怪」
data.identityProseOverride: Kaguya Shinomiya from Kaguya-sama: Love Is War, with loose black hair, parted bangs, sidelocks, red eyes and gently downturned eye corners
